replays.name: show1
replays.title: OVERDISK 💿
replays.instruction: Reach level 20 during a single fresh run. Start at level 1 with the baseball bat. Hit sawblades into the moving purple portal to earn XP; watch the level and XP bar at the upper left. Avoid taking fatal damage.

replays.name: show2
replays.title: Pico World Race
replays.instruction: Collect all 20 tokens within one USA race. You may use all three laps; finishing is not additionally required.

replays.name: show3
replays.title: Combo Pool
replays.instruction:
Earn at least 10,000 total points in this fresh Endless run. Read the lower
score at bottom left. Matching colors score points, and rebounds and collisions
increase the shot multiplier. Endless has no life limit. Press R to start over.
